A. Does recent evidence support the size of effect we assume: does this measure raise the share of lung cancer patients who get curative-intent treatment, and by how much?
Measure: Stereotactic radiotherapy pathway for early cancer in patients who cannot be operated. Every stage I patient who is too frail for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy (3-8 visits, no anaesthesia) instead of being left without treatment. The treatment exists in every university hospital; what is missing in some counties is the referral rule.
effect_summary_en: In the Netherlands, 7% fewer elderly stage I patients went untreated once stereotactic radiotherapy was fully available, but the study does not give the effect as a share of all lung cancer patients.
supported_en: A Netherlands Cancer Registry study (Annals of Oncology 2012) found 7% fewer untreated elderly stage I patients after stereotactic radiotherapy came in, and an 8-month gain in median survival.
not_supported_en: The pages read do not show the 0.8-point gain in the share of all patients, or any Finnish baseline.
in_use_quote: Jos kyseessä on pieni keuhkotuumori eikä kasvain ole paikallisesti edennyt, voidaan antaa täsmäsädehoitoa mikäli potilaan yleistila tai muut sairaudet eivät salli operatiivista hoitoa.
missing_en: No page shows a rule that every stage I patient too frail for surgery is referred for stereotactic radiotherapy.
summary_en: The KYS lung cancer care chain (published by the Pohjois-Savo wellbeing services county, dated 2021) says high-dose targeted radiotherapy ("täsmäsädehoito") can be given for small, localised tumours when the patient cannot have surgery. It also says every lung cancer patient is discussed at least once at a meeting that makes the treatment decision. Siun sote runs its own radiotherapy unit at Pohjois-Karjalan keskussairaala, but no page found says every eligible patient is referred. A Netherlands Cancer Registry study (2012) found 7% fewer untreated elderly stage I patients once the treatment was fully available, but it does not show the assumed gain for all patients.
unanswered_en: No page was found that says whether Siun sote itself gives stereotactic lung radiotherapy, or that shows a formal rule to refer every frail stage I patient.
